segments.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

footnotes.text: + for the sons: or, of the sons

heading: Psalm of the Sons of Korah

segments.text: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
And of Zion it shall be said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: that this man was born there.
As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there:

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: all my springs are in thee.
